citations.excerpt: The Vatican Council, the twentieth and up to now [1912] the last ecumenical council, opened on 8 December, 1869, and adjourned on 20 October, 1870.

facts.value: Council of the Catholic Church called by Pope Pius IX whose decrees defined the dogma of papal infallibility.

citations.excerpt: Pius IX announced, at a session of the Congregation of Rites, his intention to call a general council .
the decrees of the Vatican Council of 1870 defining the dogma of papal infallibility
